name: ai-lifesim-studio
description: Early skeleton of a plugin for making family life-sim games on a fixed Godot kernel, one theme pack per game. Only the theme-agnostic art, UI, release and writing skills are here, borrowed from AI RPG Studio; the pack-authoring skills are still to come. 生活模拟游戏（家庭、小人、房子、几代人）的插件，目前只是骨架：美术、界面、发布、文风这些和题材无关的技能借自 AI RPG Studio，填主题包的技能还没做。
